items.title: Hurricanes: current advisories and bounded weather history
items.description: Use existing cyclone advisories and weather imagery without implying a global forecast, hazard footprint or archived storm replay.
items.author: Geospatial Intelligence Hub
items.licenseNotice: Original project-authored case text under the repository MIT license. Linked articles, datasets, images and media retain their own rights; Nepal event assets retain their documented non-commercial terms.
items.adaptationNotice: Original case narrative written against the reviewed upstream pin. Citations link to evidence and reviewed primary accounts; no external article body, image, video or dataset is republished.

limitations: NHC/CPHC cyclone coverage is Atlantic and eastern/central North Pacific, not global.
Forecast cones concern the future storm center; they do not show the full hazard footprint.
Weather products have different coverage and expose at most 13 frames from the preceding 24 hours.
The globe link does not select a storm, advisory issue time, weather frame or historical replay.
caseDetails.restoredScope: Atlantic camera view on Esri imagery with cyclone advisories and weather satellite imagery enabled. No named storm, advisory time, weather frame or historical track is restored.

items.title: Launches: understanding a recent mission reconstruction
items.description: Read the existing Space Missions experience as a constrained reconstruction rather than measured continuous launch telemetry.
items.author: Geospatial Intelligence Hub
items.licenseNotice: Original project-authored case text under the repository MIT license. Linked articles, datasets, images and media retain their own rights; Nepal event assets retain their documented non-commercial terms.
items.adaptationNotice: Original case narrative written against the reviewed upstream pin. Citations link to evidence and reviewed primary accounts; no external article body, image, video or dataset is republished.

limitations: Reconstructed geometry and timing are estimates, not continuous measured vehicle telemetry.
Available mission records and orbital elements do not establish complete trajectories or successful outcomes.
Failed launches must not receive fabricated fallback orbit markers.

No upcoming-launch query, new provider, historical replay dataset or recorder is added.

items.title: Satellite imagery: an observed A/B comparison at 30 m
items.description: A user-observed October 12/13 HLS comparison shows both images render, with explicit 30 m resolution, mixed-sensor and current-window limits.
items.author: Geospatial Intelligence Hub

references.title: Recent Imagery product and box limits

items.licenseNotice: Original project-authored case text under the repository MIT license. Linked articles, datasets, images and media retain their own rights; Nepal event assets retain their documented non-commercial terms.
items.adaptationNotice: Original case narrative written against the reviewed upstream pin. Citations link to evidence and reviewed primary accounts; no external article body, image, video or dataset is republished.

limitations: User-observed coverage on October 21, 2026: A is October 13 HLS S30 and B is October 12 HLS L30. Both rendered; the agent did not independently inspect a browser.

The supplied URL records west −74.22481°, south 40.31969°, east −74.21304°, north 40.32950°. This roughly 1.0 by 1.09 km area contains only about 33 by 36 samples at 30 m; building-scale detail cannot be recovered by zooming.

The 4% and 43% cloud figures are catalog metadata, not measured cloud cover over the selected box. This mixed-sensor pair supports coverage and workflow observation, not a like-for-like ground-change conclusion.
The Esri basemap capture date is unverified. HUD GSD is derived from camera altitude and does not represent the HLS product resolution.
HLS S30/L30 are 30 m; VIIRS NOAA-21 is 250 m. The tool covers the last 30 UTC days, so the observed dates expire; each box side is limited to 1,000 km.

The globe action restores only camera, Esri map, Recent Imagery enabled, selected box and A/B mode. Image assignments, product choices and observed dates require manual selection; no archive or new service is added.
caseDetails.restoredScope: Camera at 40.3239° N, 74.2184° W, altitude 731 m, heading 342°, pitch −86°; normal style and Esri imagery; Recent Imagery enabled; box west −74.22481°, south 40.31969°, east −74.21304°, north 40.32950°; A/B mode only. No A/B image assignments, observed dates or product choices are restored; choose available candidates manually.
